description: LangChain ChatOpenAI with one bound tool: a tool call, the tool run, then the answer.
notes: Only LangChainInstrumentor is enabled. OpenInference records message content by default, and this scenario sets no content-capture environment variable. ChatOpenAI is pointed at the mock. The first chat completion calls get_weather, LangChain runs that tool, and the second completion returns the answer. bind_tools().invoke emits no chain span, so the capture is three root spans: LLM, TOOL, LLM. Token counts are copied. The second span's prompt is 131 and prompt_details.cache_read is 64. Audio, reasoning, and the first span's cache_read are written as 0. llm.finish_reason is tool_calls, then stop, on the span only. LangChain run ids are pinned to a counter so the lc_run message ids stay stable.
